content:
Shared journeys with several passengers within a single travel plan are quite memorable with Thai Airways when one chooses it as their flying partner. The national carrier runs special group travel services to take trips with companions. Moreover, the Thai Airways Group Travel feature also provides numerous offerings and additional benefits that may not be available on standard bookings. However, to access the service, there are guidelines set by the airline that need to be followed by the flyers. Fulfilling these policies makes individuals eligible to obtain all the amenities and discounts. Furthermore, one can get familiar with these rules and other related information by referring to the below-mentioned titles.

What Are the Terms & Conditions for a Group on Thai Airways?

Excursions planned with multiple companions on Thai Airways are quite simple to execute through its group travel services. However, passengers have to adhere to the terms and conditions of the carrier in order to access the facility. Moreover, by following the Thai Airways Group Booking policy, one would be able to gain the additional benefits and special rates that are designed especially for such journeys and can’t be obtained on standard reservations. This allows them to make informed choices regarding their trip and stay away from unforeseen complications. To learn more about these guidelines, refer to the pointers given below.

  • Group Size: At least 10 adult passengers traveling together in Economy Class, or 5 adult passengers in Business Class.
  • Common Itinerary: All the group members must be following a common itinerary and traveling to the same destination.
  • Discounted Rates: Discounted rates are given to the passengers, but they are also subject to certain conditions.

How Can I Book a Group Flight with Thai Airways?

Securing reservations for an entire group can be done easily with Thai Airways. This is possible because of the way the carrier provides it. It also allows passengers to fly under a single PNR without requiring them to arrange multiple separate reservations. Furthermore, to book a Thai Airways Group ticket, travelers can utilize the official website of the airline. It is a convenient and swift way to get a quote and stay coordinated among the group. For more details about the procedure, check the steps elaborated below.

  1. Go to the official online portal of Thai Airways.
  2. Then, tap on the “For Business” section and select the “MICE” option from there.
  3. On the next page, select the “Submit your proposal” option and provide the mandatory details regarding the trip.
  4. Once done, the airline will share a quote based on the given information, and you must accept it before the deadline expires.
  5. Afterwards, proceed to complete the payment process with the available methods mentioned in the contract.
  6. Finally, the confirmed travel documents will be issued to the applicant’s registered email address.

Does Thai Airways Offer Group Rates?

Indeed. Thai Airways offers discounted group rates & special fares for passengers traveling together. Furthermore, these reduced Thai Airways Group fares aid in providing a seamless journey for flyers, where they can access the premium perks without stretching their pockets. However, to obtain this affordable trip, one is required to check certain factors like route, availability, ticket or fare type, etc as they are the conditions upon which the rates are offered.

Conclusion

Therefore, taking flights with large crowds is uncomplicated with the group travel feature of Thai Airways. The facility also brings an effortless booking procedure, added privileges, and all this at cost-effective rates. This all sums up to making a Thai Airways Group reservation a fair deal for passengers. Thus, to curate a trip with companions, the above-mentioned insights should be gone through by the individuals first.
